text: Figure 6.11: Fast method invocation Please note that the async function feature of the Rust programming language will hide the poll function and its results Ready(X) and Pending from the application programmer. Pin and Waker are also implicitly added by the async/await syntactic sugar. If the invoked method depends on an external event or method invocation, it internally returns Pending, this requires moving the promise to the heap and registering a new task with the executor. If the method is not ready when unconditionally invoked next time by the executor, it will register a waking signal and return control to the executor. Then the signal wakes up the task fulfilling the promise, which then sends the result via the ara::com stack on the C++ side.
